d:
Amul aur madar deyri ne 12 navanbar se dudh ki qimten barha di hain. tond dudh do rupye aur phul krim dudh char rupye prati litar mahanga huaa hai. kanpniyon ke mutabiq, chare, pashu aahar, paiking aur dhulaee ka kharch barhne se dudh ki utpadan lagat par dabav para hai.
Lekin dudh mahanga hone ka matlab yah nahin hai ki kisanon ki kamaee bhi barh gaee hai. is riport men samjhie ki dudh ke dam barhne ki shuruaat kahan se hoti hai, fait ki qimat ka ismen kya rol hai aur desh men dudh ka utpadan barhne ke bavjud saplaee par dabav kyon bana huaa hai.
Riport: dushyant kumar
Aavaz: priyanka
